own_solution.law: Hydrostatic (gauge) pressure: p = rho_A g h_A
assumptions: g = 9.8 m/s^2 (not stated in the rendered text)
gauge pressure from column A only

defect_reasons.missing_assumption: The certified answer uses g = 9.8 m/s^2, a parameter that appears in the authors' parameter list but not in any rendered variant, so a solver using 9.81 gets 13341.6 Pa.
defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: The parenthetical 'a later note reports this same quantity as ... instead' contradicts the just-stated height of column B and makes the referent of 'this same quantity' unclear.

counterexamples: With g = 9.81 m/s^2 (a common convention), p = 13600 * 9.81 * 0.1 = 13341.6 Pa, not 13328 Pa.
notes: The governing equation, units and certified answer (13600 * 9.8 * 0.1 = 13328 Pa) are correct, and the invariance claim holds: h_B belongs to a disconnected column and has no path to the target, so all four renderings share the answer. Agrees with pass 1. The defects are in the wording: unstated g (medium; the difference is about 0.1 percent, so a tolerant grader would accept either) and a self-contradictory, templated distractor note. Fix: state g = 9.8 m/s^2 in the text and drop or reword the 'later note'.
